title: Draft Quote Object
description: Output contract for the AI draft assistant. The model returns scope and quantities only — prices are applied by the app from the PriceBook after validation, so the model has no path to inventing a number that reaches a client.

job_type.description: Snake-case identifier of the matched QuoteTemplate, e.g. domestic_scaffold_erect.

confidence.description: Confidence in the draft as a whole. Should not exceed the lowest line-item confidence.

line_items.description: Drafted line items, each traceable to the input, the template, or an inference.

assumptions.description: Everything the draft takes for granted that was not stated in the input. Empty array if none.

flags_for_owner_review.description: Points the owner must actively check before sending. Empty array if none.

similar_past_jobs_reference.description: Completed jobs supplied to the model as scale sanity-check, echoed back to show what the estimate was compared against.

line_code.description: Identifier of the line in the matched QuoteTemplate, which resolves to a PriceBook entry. Constrained at runtime to the codes the matched template offers, so the model cannot invent a line — and therefore cannot invent a price by inventing a product.

description.description: Human-readable line item label, matching the template's wording where one applies.

quantity_estimate.description: Quantity only. No price, rate, or total — the app derives cost from the PriceBook.

unit.description: Unit of measure, e.g. m2, days, job, each.

source.description: Where the quantity came from. Drives the amber-dot / tap-to-confirm rule in the Quote Builder. `photo_inferred` means it was scaled off an attached site photo, and is only valid when photos were actually supplied with the request.

note.description: Context the owner needs to judge the number. Required when the source is inferred (ai_inferred or photo_inferred) or the confidence is not high. For photo_inferred, say what the quantity was scaled against.

allOf.$comment: An inferred quantity is never high confidence — inference is by definition not stated, and a quantity scaled off a photograph is an estimate twice over.
Anything below high confidence must explain itself to the owner.

job.description: Short label for the completed job, e.g. '22 Vine Rd, scaffold erect'.

quoted.description: Final quoted total for that job, in the business's base currency.

actual_cost.description: Final actual cost for that job, in the business's base currency.

margin_actual.description: Realised margin as a percentage string, e.g. '22%'.
